title: Bangkok and Nonthaburi flood by district (live summary, 56 districts)
description: One record per district of Bangkok and Nonthaburi (56), from the ADPC GRP Bangkok flood pilot (Bangkok and Nonthaburi): the number of active and receding flood incidents, the highest-concern confidence word, and counts of schools, hospitals and clinics with flooding reported nearby. Every district is listed; zero means no incident was found, not missing data. Derived from Floodboard road ratings and public reports. Estimates, not a flood map.
source: ADPC GRP Bangkok flood pilot (derived from Floodboard: BMA, Traffy Fondue and public reports; facilities from OpenStreetMap)
cadence: Floodboard roads checked every 10 minutes; incidents recomputed whenever the export changes
license: CC BY 4.0 (derived from Floodboard, CC BY 4.0; facility counts from OpenStreetMap, ODbL)
usage_notes: Bangkok and Nonthaburi only. Pass {limit: 56} for every district; the default returns the most concerning ones. 0 active incidents means no flooding was found in the reports, not proof that a district is dry. Check valid_until on each record. Credit: Floodboard (floodboard.org), CC BY 4.0; © OpenStreetMap contributors.
